brief: Primitivo under €15 to go with steak.

criteria.notes: red, Primitivo, dry, to go with steak

searches.note: 10 results on the shop, none a Primitivo product page

shortlist.name: Santoro Primitivo Puglia 0,75 L
shortlist.reason: Dry red Primitivo from Puglia that the shop pairs with meat dishes; silver medal noted on the page. At 12% it is on the lighter side for steak.

shortlist.name: Raudonasis sausas vynas su saugoma geografine nuoroda VIGNETI DEL SALENTO I MURI PRIMITIVO PUGLIA IGP, 0,75 l
shortlist.reason: Dry red Primitivo Puglia IGP well inside the budget; the page gives no strength or pairing, so the fit with steak rests on the grape alone. Per-litre price of 13,32 €/l confirms 9.99.

notes: Only two wines: the three searches surfaced just two product pages on the five shops. The first search returned an empty result, the site:vynokambarys.lt search returned shop pages but no Primitivo product, and the third returned the Vynoteka Primitivo category page (skipped as a category page, per the skill) plus the two product pages read here. 6 of 8 page reads were left unused for lack of candidates. Neither page states stock. Producer is null for the Vynoteka wine because the page names only the supplier.
